text:
A California congressman and outspoken critic of Donald Trump unveiled a new photo hanging in his office in the Capitol.

Rep. Ted Lieu, who has sparred with the Trump administration over the Jeffrey Epstein files and the president's health, posted to X last week a photo of Trump appearing to be asleep at the Resolute Desk.

The photo is surrounded by snaps the congressman took with former President Barack Obama. "Got a new photo for my Capitol office," he wrote.

Supporters of the president went after Lieu in his comments.

"Hey Lieu do you see how ignorant you are with hatred towards one person has blocked your mind? Just think if you actually did your FKN job to improve pour nation and fix all the fraud and corruptness yea I hated time typing this dumb ass note," one user wrote.

"Can you put a picture up of how many days until re-election so I can count down to the days you get voted out of office for your fecklessness," another wrote.

The post followed a heated Congressional hearing involving Secretary of State Marco Rubio. Lieu accused the secretary of misleading a Congress when asked whether he had witnessed Trump dozing off during meetings.

Rubio, appearing before the U.S. House Foreign Affairs Committee regarding the State Department's Fiscal Year 2027 budget request, was challenged by the Democrat on the president's health.

"That's false. I've never seen him fall asleep," Rubio responded.

"On the contrary, the guy doesn't sleep, which is a big problem, because he calls me at 2 in the morning, he calls me at 5 in the morning," he continued. "And, you know, I like to sleep a little bit, maybe not 12 hours, but at least 6. So he works... The other day, he was at the Oval Office until 12:30 a.m."

Marco Rubio said he never saw Trump sleeping during meetings(Image: Getty)

Lieu interrupted, indicating that he intended to present Rubio with footage that "shows you just lied to Congress."

The Democrat then showed a video from a Cabinet meeting in May, when Trump appeared to nod off while Rubio was delivering remarks.

"So this is a video of a cabinet meeting literally from last month where Donald Trump is sleeping while you are talking," the congressman said.
